E0119

`Bogus` isn't a known effect

What

`Bogus` isn't a known effect

Why

An effect list names compiler-known effects like `Net`, `FS`, `IO`, `DB`, or `Time`

Fix

Use one of the known effect names, or remove it from the list

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0119: Tests/UI/DSLBlocks/sql_row_header_is_a_real_declared_type_position.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownType]: There's no type called `MissingRow`
  --> Tests/UI/DSLBlocks/sql_row_header_is_a_real_declared_type_position.jet:2:10
    |
  2 |     #SQL(MissingRow) {
    |          ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The types are `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, and `String` (plus types you define)
 Fix: Check the spelling, or define the struct or enum first
